target_customer: Residential remodelers, builders and trade contractors; originally construction firms buying cost data (as 1build)
problem: Construction pricing is volatile and the industry relied on annual cost books. The company offered live cost data, then AI estimating and back office tools for small contractors.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for estimating and project operations
product_category: Construction cost data and AI estimating

founders.name: Dmitry Alexin
prior_employers: Cloud Kitchens (led ML team, founding employee)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; Commercial Observer says he was a data scientist forecasting for the IMF and led data science at Cloud Kitchens. TechCrunch 2021 calls him a solo founder who briefly worked at a stealth real estate startup.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating 68 million cost datapoints across materials, labor and equipment in 2020 required scraping and normalization, standard data engineering with hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: A localized live cost dataset has some value, but incumbents like annual cost books existed and the later estimating features face copying by general AI tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The YC launch post names no incumbent, only annual cost books. In 2025 the CEO contrasted Handoff with Procore (enterprise) and ChatGPT; neither bought or copied it per the sources.

market_need_then: The launch post cites lumber rising about 400 percent before crashing in 2021 and an industry still using annual cost books. Usage fell 50 percent in the first 30 days of COVID before subscription revenue rose 7x in 10 months (TechCrunch Sep 2021).

branding.domain_note: Now handoff.ai; earlier 1build.com. The handoff.ai site links to 1build.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct copy aimed at contractors.

branding.brand_signature: Plaid for construction cost data (original YC launch pitch for 1build)

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources; USPTO shows HANDOFF filed July 2025 by 1Build, Inc.

branding.community_and_virality: 1build was selected as a TechCrunch Top 20 new startup per its own blog.

brand_strength.rationale: The renamed brand is recent and generic, the old 1build name had little reach outside construction, and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Construction cost data and estimating platform (1build)
pivots.to: AI estimator and operations agent for residential remodelers (Handoff)
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC description and 2025 coverage show the shift to small residential contractors and AI agents.

outcome_analysis: Handoff began as 1build, a cost data company, raised a seed led by Initialized and a $14.5M Series A led by Greycroft in September 2021 after subscription revenue grew 7x in ten months. It renamed to Handoff and added a $5.8M strategic round from Nemetschek and Masco in June 2025, claiming 10,000+ monthly users. It is active, small at about 20 people, with no exit.
notes: The seed date is not given by TechCrunch (a Caplight listing says November 2020, unverified). Series A reported as $14M in the headline and $14.5M in the body; the body is used. A search snippet puts total raised at $19.5M, other aggregators $25M to $30M; unverified. The 1build to Handoff link rests on the YC page listing the 1build launch under Handoff, trademark filings and the Commercial Observer and site references. The 2025 Commercial Observer article does not mention 1build. Competitor list is empty because no source dated near March 2020 naming rivals was opened. TechCrunch 2021 names no competitors.
